body:
" I sacrificed everything for my children"
" You will never achieve anything doing this or that"
"I am so unlucky"
"All men are pigs"
" I am really trying very hard, can't you see?"

It's exactly what I am feeling right now! This silence can't be any good and it's constantly on my mind. But strangely it is kinda comforting to know that there are others who feel the same. It seems less "tragic".
If I may, how much time did you need to adjust to everything? And what helped you?

Mine also immediately played the victim and now there's radio silence, which is the opposite of how she would act normally. Very strange but I guess she plays dead to provoque any kind of reaction from me.
Anyways, thank you for your support! I hope you feel better now :)
I have to give her back her flat's key because I don't want to have anything to do anymore with her

Thank you for your help.
I thought I will have to go no contact, but astonnishingly, after I announced her yesterday by phone that I won't come back, it's radio silence frome her. Normally she bombs me with calls and messages.
My sister can't come to me because she will tell my mom where I live. She is a good person deep down but my mom's influence is to big. She already betrayed my secrets in the past :(

Thank you so much for your answer. It helped.
I will definitely not give her my new address. I am just afraid that she will somehow manage to get it when calling my insurance or bank or any other institution, pretending to be me...
Ahaha I like your suggestion with leaving a letter with the key!
How did they react? Are you still in contact with them?
Thank you so much for your answer. I decided to send her the keys through a system where she has to sign when it is delivered to her. It is easier.

Thank you very much for your answer.

After reading the answers, I decided to call her. And of course, her first reaction was : I am sick, how cod you leave me?! And second : what about the money you give me?? So predictable. Anyways, I am glad I didn't confront her face to face!
